name: MonarchRatingPicker
title: RatingPicker
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.selection.selectable (Role.RadioButton) in androidx.compose.foundation.selection.selectableGroup, laid out with androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow and Row
summary: Picks one value on a rating scale: 1 to 5 by default, or any scale with a label per value, as tiles or as stars.
whenToUse: For feedback and reviews: rating a call, an article, a support answer, or a performance level with labelled steps.
whenNotToUse: For a number that is typed or stepped use MonarchNumberInput. For a continuous value use the Material 3 Slider. For a choice between named options with more text use MonarchRadioCardGroup.
api: @Composable fun MonarchRatingPicker(value: Int?, onValueChange: (Int?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, options: List<MonarchRatingOption> = MonarchRatingOption.range(), variant: MonarchRatingPickerVariant = MonarchRatingPickerVariant.Scale, size: MonarchRatingPickerSize = MonarchRatingPickerSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, clearable: Boolean = false, star: (@Composable (filled: Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchRatingPickerLabels = MonarchRatingPickerLabels())

class MonarchRatingOption(value: Int, label: String? = null) { companion object { const val DEFAULT_FIRST: Int = 1; const val DEFAULT_LAST: Int = 5; fun range(first: Int = DEFAULT_FIRST, last: Int = DEFAULT_LAST): List<MonarchRatingOption> } }
class MonarchRatingPickerLabels(valueText: ((value: Int?, max: Int, label: String?) -> String)? = null, clear: String? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The chosen value, or null for no rating yet.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the new value, or null when a clearable rating is cleared.

options.name: options
options.description: The scale, in order, with an optional label per value. range(first, last) builds a numeric scale.

options.name: variant
options.description: Scale draws tiles with the number and label; Stars draws stars with the chosen label beside them.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm has tighter tiles and 20dp stars; Md 24dp stars. Every target stays at least 48dp.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the rating can be changed.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Shows the rating at full strength, ignores taps and is read as one value.

options.name: clearable
options.description: Choosing the chosen value again clears the rating, and TalkBack gets a "Clear rating" action.

options.name: star
options.description: Replaces the drawn star with the app's own icon. It is decoration.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the spoken value ("3 of 5", "3 of 5, Good", "No rating") and "Clear rating".

states.name: no rating
states.description: No tile is chosen and every star is an outline.

states.name: rated
states.description: The chosen tile has the accent subtle fill and a 2dp accent border; stars up to the value are filled in the warning strong color.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The Material ripple over the tile or star.

states.name: focused
states.description: The Monarch focus ring around the tile or star.

states.name: read only
states.description: Looks like the rated state and does not respond.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Subtle tiles and the disabled text color; stars in the disabled text color.

appearance: Tiles use the surface color, muted text and the default border; the chosen tile the accent subtle fill, default text and the accent border at 2dp. Filled stars use the warning strong color and empty stars an outline in the strong border color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web is a radio group with arrow keys, and Android keeps that model: each value is a radio button in a selectableGroup, which TalkBack reads with its position. iOS exposes the picker as one adjustable element instead. Clearing is a second tap or a custom action, in place of Delete and Backspace. Monarch bundles no icons, so the stars are drawn as a five-pointed shape; the star slot takes the app's own icon. The web's invalid and required states and form name are not offered.
accessibility: The values are radio buttons in one selectableGroup; the chosen one is read as selected.
A tile is named by its number and label; a star by "3 of 5" with the label, if any.
A clearable rating with a value has a "Clear rating" custom action.
A read-only picker is one element named by the label, with the value as its state, for example "4 of 5".
Every tile and star reserves a touch target of at least 48dp by 48dp and draws the focus ring.
The rating is not color alone: the chosen tile has a heavier border, stars are filled or outlined, and the stars variant shows the chosen label as text.
Tiles wrap onto more lines at font scale 2.0 instead of cutting text.
edgeCases: A value that is not on the scale shows no rating.
The spoken maximum is the last option's value, so a scale from 0 to 10 is read "7 of 10".
Long tile labels make wider tiles; keep them to a word or two.

examples.title: Labelled scale
examples.template:
MonarchRatingPicker(
    value = rating,
    onValueChange = { rating = it },
    label = {{label}},
    options = listOf(
        MonarchRatingOption({{options.0.value}}, {{options.0.label}}),
        MonarchRatingOption({{options.1.value}}, {{options.1.label}}),
        MonarchRatingOption({{options.2.value}}, {{options.2.label}}),
        MonarchRatingOption({{options.3.value}}, {{options.3.label}}),
        MonarchRatingOption({{options.4.value}}, {{options.4.label}}),
    ),
)
examples.code:
MonarchRatingPicker(
    value = rating,
    onValueChange = { rating = it },
    label = "Overall rating",
    options = listOf(
        MonarchRatingOption(1, "Below"),
        MonarchRatingOption(2, "Partly meets"),
        MonarchRatingOption(3, "Meets"),
        MonarchRatingOption(4, "Exceeds"),
        MonarchRatingOption(5, "Outstanding"),
    ),
)

examples.title: Stars with a label per value
examples.code:
MonarchRatingPicker(
    value = rating,
    onValueChange = { rating = it },
    label = "Rate this answer",
    options = listOf(
        MonarchRatingOption(1, "Not helpful"),
        MonarchRatingOption(2, "Somewhat helpful"),
        MonarchRatingOption(3, "Helpful"),
    ),
    variant = MonarchRatingPickerVariant.Stars,
)

examples.title: Read only
examples.code:
MonarchRatingPicker(
    value = 4,
    onValueChange = {},
    label = "Average rating",
    variant = MonarchRatingPickerVariant.Stars,
    readOnly = true,
)
